title: Just Weights and Levirate Marriage

questions.question: What is the limit of blows for a guilty man?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 25:3 (ESV): "Forty stripes may be given him, but not more, lest... your brother be degraded in your sight."

questions.question: What animal law is given regarding threshing?
options: You shall not muzzle an ox when it is treading out the grain
You shall not harness a donkey
questions.correctAnswer: You shall not muzzle an ox when it is treading out the grain
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 25:4 (ESV): "You shall not muzzle an ox when it is treading out the grain."

questions.question: If brothers dwell together and one dies without a son, what must the living brother do?
options: Take her as his wife (Levirate marriage) to raise up offspring
questions.correctAnswer: Take her as his wife (Levirate marriage) to raise up offspring
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 25:5 (ESV): "...her husband's brother shall go in to her and take her as his wife..."

questions.question: What happens if the man refuses to take his brother's wife?
options: She pulls the sandal off his foot and spits in his face
questions.correctAnswer: She pulls the sandal off his foot and spits in his face
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 25:9 (ESV): "then his brother's wife shall go up to him... and pull his sandal off his foot and spit in his face..."

questions.question: What must you have in your bag regarding weights?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 25:15 (ESV): "A full and fair weight you shall have, a full and fair measure you shall have..."

questions.question: Who attacked Israel on the way out of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 25:17 (ESV): "Remember what Amalek did to you on the way as you came out of Egypt..."

questions.question: How did Amalek attack?
options: He attacked the stragglers at the rear when you were faint and weary
questions.correctAnswer: He attacked the stragglers at the rear when you were faint and weary
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 25:18 (ESV): "how he attacked you on the way when you were faint and weary, and cut off... all who were lagging behind you..."

questions.question: What is the command regarding Amalek?
options: Blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven
questions.correctAnswer: Blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 25:19 (ESV): "...you shall blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven; you shall not forget."

questions.question: What if a woman intervenes in a fight by grabbing the secrets (genitals)?
options: You shall cut off her hand; your eye shall have no pity
questions.correctAnswer: You shall cut off her hand; your eye shall have no pity
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 25:11–12 (ESV): "...and puts out her hand and seizes him by the private parts, then you shall cut off her hand..."

questions.question: Why must weights be fair?
options: That your days may be long in the land
questions.correctAnswer: That your days may be long in the land
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 25:15 (ESV): "...that your days may be long in the land that the Lord your God is giving you."

questions.question: The house of the man who refuses Levirate marriage shall be called what?
options: The house of him who had his sandal pulled off
questions.correctAnswer: The house of him who had his sandal pulled off
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 25:10 (ESV): "And the name of his house shall be called in Israel, 'The house of him who had his sandal pulled off.'"

questions.question: Those who do injustice with weights are what to God?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 25:16 (ESV): "For all who do such things, all who act dishonestly, are an abomination to the Lord your God."

questions.question: The first son born to the widow in Levirate marriage shall succeed to whose name?
options: The name of his dead brother
questions.correctAnswer: The name of his dead brother
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 25:6 (ESV): "And the first son... shall succeed to the name of his dead brother..."

questions.question: Amalek did not do what regarding God?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 25:18 (ESV): "...and he did not fear God."

questions.question: Where do the elders sit for judgment?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 25:7 (ESV): "...Go up to the gate to the elders..."

key_verse_text: A full and fair weight you shall have, a full and fair measure you shall have, that your days may be long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you. (ESV)
